Three explicit ordered orthogonal pairs yield the lower envelope. For the upper bound, on each affine path, profile branch, and ordered facet pair the two excess expressions are affine in the path parameter, so a common positive excess could occur at endpoints or a crossing. Critical weights are roots of four endpoint polynomials and a determinant, all degree<=2; the inspected exact rational Python verifier checks these algebraic intervals with 3840 critical polynomial instances and 2488 test points. Separately reconstructed exact rational finite-path optimizations at seven rational weights matched the asserted formula, including all change points. The interval-boundary calculation then gives reflection asymmetry 1/40.
